sources.title: To Build Truly Intelligent Machines, Teach Them Cause and Effect
sources.quote_checked: All the impressive achievements of deep learning amount to just curve fitting. | If a machine does not have a model of reality, you cannot expect the machine to behave intelligently in that reality. | Associations are not enough -- and this is a mathematical fact, not opinion.

sources.title: What Statisticians Want to Know about Causal Inference and The Book of Why

sources.quote_checked: most statisticians are watching these debates as outsiders, instead of trying out simple examples from beginning to end. | the bulk of mainstream statistics has been glaringly disinterested in causal matters. | the differences are more among historical traditions, or 'frameworks' than among scientific principles. | Avoiding graphs conceals what knowledge one has, as well as what doubts one entertains. | the Rosetta Stone of causal analysis
